method: Same measured Panda flange FK, 2/5/10 mm whole-path curvature detector. Paired six seeds. Phase boundaries remain approximate controller alignment guards, close/release/withdraw ends for both controllers; contact correction begins before guard, so controller-phase attribution is imperfect. No pooled-trajectory averaging or population humanlike claim.
